questions.stem: What is the term for figures that have the same shape and size?
questions.solution: Figures that have the same shape and size are called congruent. This term specifically describes shapes that can be perfectly superimposed on each other. The other options, such as 'similar' or 'equal,' do not fully capture the exact match in both shape and size required for congruence.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct way to denote that two triangles are congruent?
questions.solution: The correct way to denote congruence between two triangles is △ABC ≅ △XYZ. This notation shows that the corresponding vertices A, B, and C match with X, Y, and Z respectively. The other options either reverse the order of vertices incorrectly (like △ACB ≅ △XYZ) or mix up the order of the second triangle (like △ABC ≅ △XZY).

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दो त्रिभुजों के सर्वांगसम होने के लिए सही तरीका है?
hi.solution: दो त्रिभुजों के सर्वांगसम होने के लिए सही तरीका △ABC ≅ △XYZ है। यह प्रतीक दर्शाता है कि संगत शीर्ष A, B और C क्रमशः X, Y और Z के साथ मेल खाते हैं। अन्य विकल्प शीर्षों के क्रम को गलत तरीके से उल्टा कर देते हैं (जैसे △ACB ≅ △XYZ) या दूसरे त्रिभुज के क्रम को भ्रमित कर देते हैं (जैसे △ABC ≅ △XZY)।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi mathematical terminology.

mr.solution: दोन त्रिकोणांच्या एकरूपतेचा योग्य प्रकार दर्शविण्यासाठी △ABC ≅ △XYZ वापरला जातो. ही नोटेशन दर्शविते की संगत शिरोबिंदू A, B आणि C हे क्रमाने X, Y आणि Z शी मेळ जुमातात. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये शिरोबिंदूंचा क्रम चुकीचा असतो (जसे △ACB ≅ △XYZ) किंवा दुसऱ्या त्रिकोणाचा क्रम चुकीचा असतो (जसे △ABC ≅ △XZY).
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of an equilateral triangle?
questions.solution: An equilateral triangle has all sides and angles equal. Each angle in such a triangle measures 60°, making all angles the same. The other options describe triangles with different properties, such as right angles or unequal sides.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का गुण है?

questions.stem: If two triangles have the same side lengths, what can be said about them?
choices: They are similar but not congruent
They are neither similar nor congruent
questions.solution: If two triangles have the same side lengths, they are congruent. This is known as the SSS (Side-Side-Side) condition for congruence. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the properties of triangles with equal side lengths.

questions.stem: In a right-angled triangle, which side is called the hypotenuse?
choices: The side adjacent to the right angle
The side opposite to the right angle
The side that is neither adjacent nor opposite
questions.solution: The hypotenuse is the side opposite to the right angle because it is the longest side and is directly across from the 90° angle. The side adjacent to the right angle is one of the legs, not the hypotenuse. The side that is neither adjacent nor opposite does not exist in a triangle, and the side that is always 90° is an angle, not a side.

hi.stem: एक समकोण त्रिभुज में, कौन-सी भुजा को कर्ण कहा जाता है?

hi.solution: कर्ण समकोण के विपरीत भुजा होती है क्योंकि यह सबसे लंबी भुजा होती है और 90° कोण के सीधे विपरीत होती है। समकोण के समीप की भुजा एक पैर होती है, कर्ण नहीं। जो न तो समीप हो और न विपरीत हो, ऐसी भुजा त्रिभुज में नहीं होती, और जो हमेशा 90° हो, वह एक कोण होता है, भुजा नहीं।

questions.stem: If two right-angled triangles have their hypotenuses and one side equal, what can be concluded about their congruence?
choices: They are similar but not congruent
They are neither congruent nor similar
questions.solution: If two right-angled triangles have their hypotenuses and one side equal, they must be congruent because this satisfies the RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side) congruence criterion. The other options are incorrect because congruence is guaranteed by this condition, and similarity without congruence would require only proportional sides, not equal ones.

questions.stem: Meera and Rabia measured the sides of a triangle as 40 cm, 60 cm, and 80 cm. Rabia suggested measuring the angles to create a congruent triangle. Meera disagreed. Who is correct?
choices: Meera is correct because side lengths are sufficient
Rabia is correct because angles are necessary
Both are correct because both are needed
Both are incorrect because neither is sufficient
questions.solution: Meera is correct because side lengths alone are sufficient to create a congruent triangle. This is based on the SSS condition for congruence, which states that if two triangles have the same side lengths, they are congruent. The other options are incorrect because they either overcomplicate the process or misunderstand the congruence condition.

questions.stem: If two triangles have the same side lengths, which condition guarantees their congruence?
questions.solution: The SSS condition states that if all three sides of one triangle are equal to the corresponding sides of another triangle, then the triangles are congruent. This directly applies when two triangles have the same side lengths. The other conditions, such as ASA, AAS, and RHS, require specific combinations of sides and angles, which are not provided in this scenario.

hi.stem: यदि दो त्रिभुजों की सभी भुजाओं की लंबाई समान हो, तो कौन-सी शर्त उनके एकरूपता की गारंटी देती है?
hi.solution: SSS शर्त बताती है कि यदि एक त्रिभुज की तीनों भुजाएं दूसरे त्रिभुज की संगत भुजाओं के बराबर हों, तो त्रिभुज एकरूप होते हैं। यह सीधे तौर पर तब लागू होती है जब दो त्रिभुजों की भुजाओं की लंबाई समान हो। अन्य शर्तों, जैसे ASA, AAS और RHS, में भुजाओं और कोणों के विशिष्ट संयोजन की आवश्यकता होती है, जो इस परिस्थिति में उपलब्ध नहीं हैं।

mr.stem: जर दोन त्रिकोणांच्या बाजूंच्या लांबी समान असतील, तर कोणती अट त्यांच्या एकरूपतेची खात्री देते?
mr.solution: SSS अट सांगते की जर एका त्रिकोणाच्या तीन बाजू दुसऱ्या त्रिकोणाच्या संगत बाजूंशी समान असतील तर त्रिकोण एकरूप असतात. ही अट दोन त्रिकोणांच्या बाजूंच्या समान लांबीमुळे सीधा लागू होते. इतर अटी, जसे की ASA, AAS आणि RHS, ज्यांना विशिष्ट बाजू आणि कोनांच्या संयोजनाची आवश्यकता असते, जे या परिस्थितीत उपलब्ध नसतात.
